text:
sarah (AE): Hey team — large EU prospect (health-tech) asking for a 12mo committed plan with data residency in Frankfurt, enterprise SSO, and SOC2 paperwork. They want a bespoke rate: proposing 40% off list for a 1.2M USD commit. What's feasible? 

mike (AM): GL; do we have usage profile? are they asking for up-front or monthly? 

sarah (AE): Estimated 300k tokens/day (peaks) -> ~9M tokens/mo. Prefer monthly billing but with annual commitment (12x monthly). Asking for 40% because competitor quoted 35%. 

finance-bot: Rate card attached: base-hosted-generation $0.0025/token, embeddings $0.0007/token. Volume tiers: 10-50M: 20% off, 50-200M: 30% off, >200M: 40% off (requires exec approval). 

rachel (Finance): @sarah can you share expected TTM ARR and net new revenue? Also which add-ons (dedicated, private)? 

sarah (AE): Prospect wants Redwood Private (VPC) and Dedicated for inference. TCV approx $1.2M ARR, gross margin expectations high. 

elaine (Head of Sales): Re: discount — standard authority: AMs can approve up to 20% without deal desk. Head of Sales can approve up to 30% for strategic accounts. Anything >30% needs RevOps + CFO signoff. @rachel please flag if the margin hit is ok. 

mike (AM): @elaine if we recommend 35% to win vs competitor, what extra concessions are required? They also ask for a 99.95% SLA, 24/7 support and a legal redline on data residency. 

tom (Legal): SLA + data residency doable but Legal will need to review redlines; could require additional indemnities. That may need to be escalated to PMs for technical feasibility. 

rachel (Finance): Quick calc: with 35% off list, blended gross margin falls below target for Hosted but is acceptable for Dedicated/Private (higher per-unit price). If we include a 12mo commit with monthly payments, and require a 20% non-refundable onboarding fee, margin recovers. 

sarah (AE): Can we craft an offer: 32% off list, 12mo commit, 20% onboarding/POC fee, and a capped 3-month POC credit? 

deal-bot: Approval checklist: requires (1) Finance sign-off, (2) Head of Sales, (3) Legal review, (4) CRO for >30% discounts. 

elaine (Head of Sales): I'm ok to provisionally approve 32% for this account given strategic fit (EU health). @rachel, get final go/no-go. @tom please begin legal redline. I'll loop in CRO if rachel says margin ok. 

rachel (Finance): Approved conditionally: margin ok with 20% onboarding + standard payment terms (Net30) and 12mo commit. Needs CRO signoff for >30% but I'll prepare the Deal Review packet. 

mike (AM): Thanks. I'll draft the quote with these terms and include the technical POC scope. Draft to customer should call out: data residency in DE, Dedicated capacity, 99.95% SLA, 12mo commit, 32% discount, 20% onboarding fee, max 3mo POC credit. 

sarah (AE): Perfect. Will schedule exec intro if CRO needed. 

deal-bot: Next steps logged. esk:deal-12345

sarah (AE): FYI for records: cc @elaine @rachel @tom. 

mike (AM): tagging legal + finance for final artifacts. 

elaine (Head of Sales): Thanks team. Keep it tight on the POC scope so credits don't balloon. :thumbsup:
